misreadings.quote: When she finally does come in, she will faint at the sight of him on the wall over the picture.
misreadings.explanation: The text read so far has the mother only held back from entering. Nothing shows her fainting later or Gregor climbing the wall over the picture, and the reflection states it as certain fact rather than as a guess.

result.note: Only the original reflection contains a misreading, a confident claim about a later scene the reader had not yet read; the prose rendering stays within the text.
